title: The Letter S, by Donald Knuth (1980) [pdf]
summary: A classic 1980 article by Donald Knuth analyzing the typographic design of the letter 'S' with mathematical precision, demonstrating the intersection of computer science and typography that influenced his development of the TeX typesetting system.
problem_solved: Addresses the challenge of understanding and achieving mathematical precision in typographic letterform design, particularly for the complex curve of the letter 'S'.
why_valuable: Provides foundational insights into automated, mathematically-precise typography that shaped modern digital typesetting and remains relevant for understanding letterform aesthetics.
